from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,os,stat
root=Path('/home/postedism/Desktop/Warden')
n=Path('/tmp/warden-task15-green-22c7197f-968f62de')
st=n.lstat()
assert stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) and st.st_uid==1000 and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o700
fd=os.open(n,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
meta={}
for name in ('status.txt','unittest.txt'):
    f=os.open(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,dir_fd=fd)
    st=os.fstat(f)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_uid==1000 and st.st_nlink==1 and 0<st.st_size<65536 and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o600
    with os.fdopen(f,'rb') as stream:b=stream.read(65536)
    assert len(b)==st.st_size
    with (root/'docs/evidence/task-15/local-cover-first-20261025'/name).open('xb') as out:out.write(b)
    meta[name]={'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'uid':st.st_uid,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)),'nlink':st.st_nlink}
    print('FULL '+name+' BEGIN\n'+b.decode()+'FULL '+name+' END')
os.close(fd)
tree=ast.parse((root/'.superpowers/sdd/2-warden-security-plan/task-15-cover-admitted.py.txt').read_bytes())
node=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='frozen' for t in n.targets))
frozen=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
for name,(size,h) in frozen.items():
    b=(root/name).read_bytes()
    assert len(b)==size and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h
meta.update({'namespace':str(n),'frozen_inputs_unchanged':len(frozen),'source_bytes':sum(v[0] for v in frozen.values()),'children_created_by_caller':False,'cryptographic_acceptance':'UNRUN'})
with (root/'docs/evidence/task-15/local-cover-first-20261025/postread.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(meta,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(meta))
